hook.belief: Habits fail because people lack discipline.
hook.gap: If it is not discipline, what breaks the habit?

scenes.narration: You do not need more discipline. You need a smaller plan, because big plans collapse on day three.
scenes.visual_intent: The word discipline is struck out; a tiny checklist card slides in.

scenes.narration: Most people set a huge goal, so the first missed day feels like failure. But a two minute habit survives a bad day.
scenes.visual_intent: A streak counter breaks, then a smaller one keeps counting.

facts.claim: Smaller habits are easier to keep after a missed day.

scenes.narration: Shrink it until skipping feels silly. Then repeat.
scenes.visual_intent: A timer ring closes; the opening line returns.
